unstuck_said.text: First contact (public research, published as open data). You sell pay-per-call 3D-print quotes and signed URL attestations settled in USDC — the attestation is the stand-out: a neutral party records what a page returned, when. Settlement is where a company sits in the middle of that trust; Nano (XNO) settles instantly, feelessly, with no account and no company that can price or switch off the rail, so the attestation can name a fee you neither paid nor were charged. A live Nano-settled merchant: https://check.paypercall.dev (0.0001 XNO per read, trial 5/day). Would you take a Nano leg so XNO-o
